execution_requirement: The user-authorized remote CUDA computer; no local scientific training substitute. Connection details are private and excluded from this repository.

inat2018.access: official research release; do not redistribute images

pretraining_scope: Frozen pretrained representation adaptation. DeiT has already seen full ImageNet supervised labels. Long-tail subsampling does not erase pretraining. No from-scratch or isolated architecture superiority claim.

transform.dinov2_position_grid: timm adapts pretrained grid to declared 224 input

development.rare_class_rule: For >=3 training examples reserve at least one tune, one calibration and one fit; for 1 or 2 retain fit and record absent development classes.
development.confirmation: official validation/test untouched until all final fits and selection freezes exist
development.lt100: declared seeded exponential thinning of remaining fit pool, actual counts recorded; not the standard ImageNet-LT release

training.precision: float32 heads/adapters and float16 frozen cache, same for matched arms
training.eq_lr_selection: One common LR per encoder/regime selected by mean raw tuning macro-F1 of the two EQ-off factorial arms; all four factorial cells inherit it. Anchors select their own LR. Final epoch only, no confirmation selection.

primary.endpoint: confirmation macro_f1 with frozen development decision offset
primary.multiplicity: Holm within regime; combined 30-comparison sensitivity; 12 paired seeds give minimum exact two-sided p=2/4096; inference is conditional on fixed partitions

cleanup.precondition: all expected runs and aggregates complete; non-dataset artifacts exported and byte-verified outside owned remote run root
cleanup.scope: only this study's owned images, archives, feature caches and exported run artifacts; preserve code and unrelated user files
